title: ר' מני בריה דר' יונה

paragraphs: R. Mani son of R. Yonah, before R. Yitzḥak ben Elyashiv (see his entry). His wife was ugly and became beautiful, etc., and several miracles occurred for him (see R. Yonah), Seder Ta'aniyot 23b; see there at length. His father R. Yonah was R. Yose son of R. Ḥanina's partner in jars of wine. When R. Yonah died, R. Mani told R. Yose, 'Every barrel marked Yonah is mine,' Jerusalem Talmud, Ma'aser Sheni 4, halakhah 9. R. Mana said, 'R. Yonah my father,' Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Shekalim 3; Rosh HaShanah 1, end of halakhah 1. He asked his father R. Yonah and R. Bun bar Kahana, Jerusalem Talmud, end of Mo'ed Katan 1. R. Mani objects; R. Yonah told him, Nedarim 1(9b). When R. Mana (bar Yonah) taught a group things he had heard from his father in the assembly house, he said, 'Thus R. Yonah said'; if he heard them from his father at home, he said, 'Thus my teacher said in R. Yonah's name,' Jerusalem Talmud, end of Megillah, halakhah 10. R. Abba bar Elyashiv lived in his time. Yuḥasin, under he, at Huna among the Land of Israel's pious, writes 'R. Yonah and R. Mani his father'—should read 'his son.'
